resources.name: Fe-C-Mn thermodynamic database (TDB file)
resources.access: Publicly available Fe-C-Mn thermodynamic database (e.g., from the pycalphad sample database collection or the NIST SRD database). The agent must locate and load an appropriate TDB file for the Fe-C-Mn system.

resources.name: Carbon diffusivity in austenite
resources.access: Standard Arrhenius expression from literature (e.g., D = 0.02 exp(-Q/RT) cm²/s with Q ≈ 122 kJ/mol). The agent may use a well-established literature value; no specific reference is mandated.
